userDirection: C版奇幻像素美术风格；自然上下战场分布，不固定双页形式；双方独立保留施法区、言灵区、解析区、行动区、灰烬区。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete new WizardCard gameplay UI concept. Reference image is ONLY a MATERIAL/COLOR/PIXEL-ART STYLE reference. User explicitly requests a NATURAL TACTICAL BATTLEFIELD LAYOUT, NOT a two-page book. Completely abandon the left/right book page architecture, leather book spine, book binding, literal open book shape and sheet-of-paper chapter composition. Retain its fantasy pixel aesthetic: warm pale parchment play surface, dark burgundy leather inset dock, subtle aged gold corner hardware, clear dark brown ink, jade selected outline. Modern polished game usability with classical fantasy material vocabulary. Flat full viewport screen capture; landscape 1920x1080 16:9 requested. Pixel-art illustrations and textured borders, clean readable Chinese text.

NEW NATURAL SPATIAL ARCHITECTURE: opponent across TOP of battlefield, player across BOTTOM, facing each other through central casting lanes. No side-by-side opponents. Main central battlefield roughly x=200..1510, y=130..860; quiet continuous parchment surface with thin zone dividers, restrained corner flourishes, no individual giant rectangular chapters. Right narrow readonly inspector x~1530..1900, left utility/chain strip x~20..180. Bottom hand dock y~865..1020. Slim TOP resources/navigation y~15..120. All coordinates approximate composition guidance, not printed text.

ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED: BOTH player halves independently show all FIVE exact Chinese zone headings, ten visible headings in total:
- "解析区": with small upright spell cards grouped directly under their own host formation, visible progress/state labels and fine clear host links. Formation itself has separate "阵法区" heading and tiny five-unit space occupancy track; one hexagram base occupies2 units plus auxiliary1, two remaining units indicated as compact empty marks, not huge boxes. TWO formed host groups for each side arranged horizontally, clearly separated; formation sigils small beside their spell rails.
- "施法区": broad thin horizontal card lane nearest battlefield CENTER. Opponent casting lane above midpoint, player's below midpoint. Exactly two distinct labeled casting lanes, each can scroll and host several prepared/sustaining spell cards. Do not replace labels with queue or share one unlabeled casting region.
- "言灵区": compact panel to RIGHT of that side's analysis area, one silver quill card + one facedown trap, upright label.
- "行动区": compact transient resolution pad to LEFT of that side's analysis area, one small action card or quiet empty state. Clear region label. No numbered action allowance, no max-three-action tokens.
- "灰烬区": spent-card stack and count4 on OUTER LEFT MARGIN of each side near its deck tab, clear readable heading. Distinct from deck "牌库", count16. Gray ash isn't a generic cemetery icon with missing label.
Mirror placement top/bottom enough to understand ownership, keep all labels upright. Pale reddish opponent region accents, jade player accents, neutral parchment background. Every card visibly belongs to a named zone; do not omit either side's ACTION or ASH region to make space. Keep headers larger than incidental card text.

MIDPOINT between the two casting lanes is a slim decorative magical divider, not a giant oval portal. Shared "公开连锁" is in the LEFT UTILITY STRIP with idle nodes and label "暂无连锁"; distinct from the two 施法区 lanes. Current-task message near hand rather than huge central empty container.

Opponent narrow resource ribbon across top battlefield: life30/40 mana8/12 load2/10 plus five card BACKS count5. Player own resource ribbon immediately above hand: life38/40 mana3/12 load8/10. Heart/crystal/burden icons, clean bars. WizardCard wordmark upper left, five-phase progress strip top middle (抽卡 / 准备 / 主要 / 施法 / 结束), 主要 active, 第8回合, setting/log small upper right.
Bottom hand: six clear cards 火球术 / 炽燃结界 / 奥术圆环 / 逆三角星符 / 阿克乌姆之弧 / 心如止水. Selected fireball slightly lifted and jade outlined; floating 开始解析 above selected hand card. Far bottom-right global 结束主要阶段.
Right inspector: read-only fireball art, title 火球术, 解析3 / 施法1, 位阶2 and brief legible effect; no execute button. Do not crowd a full decorative oversized fantasy card frame around inspector.
Each player's analysis row has progress and ring-occupancy indicators, one independent attached-rune badge. Small counter/count chips for region overflow. Warm fantasy parchment STYLE like reference, but continuous natural tactical field organization. Tight useful density, breathing room, varied panel proportions, no book-shaped frame, no medieval room background or characters, no smoky effects masking text, no duplicated giant blank slots. High-quality actionable full UI mockup, all ten required zone titles visible and legible.
status: Visual concept for review, not runtime implementation.
